title: Playwright Auto Healer Fix: Error: Cashier iframe should show "Deposit" nav button
body:
## Failing test case(s)

- [VERIFY Launchpad Icon Redirections for Real Account (firefox)](https://app.testdino.com/org_69fc32be4a820df27cf28aa2/projects/project_69fc32c04a820df27cf28ac2/test-runs/test_run_9ff1413b5a17308a541de51c/be5301b1d2e3632bced9-599c50e3d08739e155bc)
- [VERIFY Launchpad Icon Redirections for Real Account (chromium-mobile)](https://app.testdino.com/org_69fc32be4a820df27cf28aa2/projects/project_69fc32c04a820df27cf28ac2/test-runs/test_run_1eddc1c43c48b37636c321f0/be5301b1d2e3632bced9-890dd280b6db8e60bf0d)

## What is failing

The "Share your real name" modal (`deposit-payment-agent-modal-share-real-name`) on the Payment Agent deposit page blocks the back-button click on the first attempt, causing the test to retry with a stale cashier URL — which then shows "cashier links cannot be reused" and `#nav-depositbtn a` times out at `CashierPage.ts:1583`.

## Evidence

PR #2593 ("feat: payment agent share name", merged 2026-07-31) introduced the "Share your real name" modal to `src/features/deposit/components/payment-agent-share-real-name-modal.tsx`. The modal intercepts pointer events over the back button (confirmed by retry1 screenshot: modal visible, back button unreachable). The retry then navigates back to the USD cashier page where the token-bound URL is already invalidated, producing the "link cannot be reused" error in the iframe instead of `#nav-depositbtn a`.

Note: CLI verification was blocked by environment permissions in this runner (staging credentials not available); the fix was validated through visual artifact inspection and src/ testid confirmation.

## Changes

- `playwright/pages/CashierPage.ts`: Added `shareRealNameModal` / `shareRealNameModalMaybeLaterButton` locators and `dismissShareRealNameModalIfPresent()` action that clicks "Maybe later" if the modal is visible.
- `playwright/pages/HomePage.ts`: Added `dismissShareRealNameModalIfPresent()` call between `verifyPaymentAgentDepositPage()` and `depositPaymentAgentBackButton.click()` in `verifyMorePageForReal()`.

> [!NOTE]
> This PR was opened after the healer agent's sample Playwright CLI verification (pass, or original signature fixed with an unrelated/downstream failure). Review the diff before merging.
